C0134.title: 12 Players Face Criminal Charges for Illegal Top-Ups, Sega and Square Enix Lose Over 1 Billion Yen
C0134.summary: The Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department filed charges against 12 players, with 4 arrested and 8 referred to prosecutors. The players contacted top-up providers through RMT sites, paying only 2% to 6% of the official price for in-game currency.
